note: UR-08: the topic sets the palette range; colour names are words for prompts and grades, not hex (colours of the UI live in palette.json). The palette moves with progress: the colour itself tells the arc.
style_suffix: , painterly storybook illustration, warm hand-painted colours, visible ink linework, soft watercolour texture, no text, no letters

day1.story: nothing but nature: earth, fire, water, sky

month1.story: clay, fields and the first green copper

years2_10.story: glass, wire and the first electric light

year50.story: steam, rails and a lit village

archetypes.newton: the proud grump who disagrees with everyone, and the loudest critic of any plan
archetypes.einstein: the dreamy improviser, brilliant and absent-minded, solves the physics and forgets the socks
archetypes.curie: the exact and stubborn one, calm under pressure, trusts only what she can measure
archetypes.darwin: the careful observer who will not touch what he cannot name
archetypes.tesla: the anxious perfectionist who redesigns everything and trusts nobody's plan
archetypes.franklin: the organiser and schemer, a committee in one coat, always three steps ahead and enjoying it
archetypes.nansen: the tough pragmatist who has actually survived ice and hunger and has no patience for theory
archetypes.wallace: the quiet field naturalist who finds the useful thing while others argue
archetypes.snow: the methodical doctor obsessed with clean water who will say it again, louder
archetypes.archimedes: the eager tinkerer who tries to build a machine for everything

note_rule_base: rule_base 2 = UR-16..UR-20 (D-40): stakes in every frame, named heroes with emotional poses in every B shot
figure_style: , every person and hand drawn as an exaggerated storybook caricature: head about 1.6x oversized, large expressive hands, thick brown ink outline, flat watercolour fill, simple cel shading

style_bridge.note: a sheet with a sprite and a pod-painted person and hand in one frame; the creator approves it once per episode
